scope: RG-K K0–K3 minimal text/keyword Wiki engineering profile

assertions: byte-identical import is idempotent
same paper new bytes creates a version
different paper identity is not merged
UTF-8 byte locators round-trip CRLF, CJK and emoji
no synthetic page numbers
known source retrieval is deterministic
unsupported exact value remains unknown
tie ordering is stable
context limit records omissions
unlisted source, task and scope are denied before body disclosure
denial has no model or process side effect
claim refs must be in the submitted evidence pack
local observation requires a verified result and conditions ref
new source version marks dependent current claims stale
old immutable bytes remain hash-addressable
revoked source body cannot be read
Wiki update is compare-and-swap
same-condition contradictory claims stay conflicted
different conditions remain separate
actual downstream task input records EvidencePack and chunk refs
result, cost and error remain tied to that task call
independent recompute verifies bytes, locator, conditions and manifest
source or evidence hash tampering is rejected
